feed.headline: Germany's far-right AfD celebrate projected win in state election
feed.ai: AfD leaders celebrated tonight as exit polls projected a big lead in the Saxony-Anhalt vote.

feed.headline: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
feed.ai: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

feed.headline: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
feed.ai: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

feed.headline: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
feed.ai: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

feed.headline: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
feed.ai: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

feed.headline: Russian Strikes on Ukraine Hits Near David Petraeus, ex-C.I.A. Chief
feed.ai: David Petraeus was at a rail station when a drone hit. Another train, with former Prime Minister Boris Johnson of Britain and other dignitaries, had just left, Ukrainian officials said.

feed.headline: In Doonbeg, Trump’s Irish Open Visit Prompts Protests and Praise
feed.ai: As the U.S. president heads to his Doonbeg hotel for the Irish Open, locals expressed both appreciation for the resort’s economic benefits and opposition to his politics.

feed.headline: Saudi pipeline shutdown threatens oil exports to Europe and Asia as kingdom relies on stored supplies
feed.ai: The pipeline disruption comes as Gulf oil exports have already fallen sharply and shipping routes face further threats. With no restart date announced, the impact on deliveries to Europe and Asia depends on how long the shutdown lasts.

feed.headline: Drone strikes hit key Ukraine-Poland supply route, sparking border fires
feed.ai: Ukraine said a Russian drone strike ignited a fire at a petrol station near the Yahodyn–Dorohusk border crossing with Poland in the early hours of Sunday, 13 September. Video filmed close to the crossing showed flames and thick smoke as firefighters tackled the blaze.

feed.headline: Close race in Sweden as hard right eyes role in government
feed.ai: Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has promised cabinet jobs for the Sweden Democrats, but the rival left-wing bloc has a narrow lead in the polls.

feed.headline: Russia's new jet-powered drones outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily launches
feed.ai: The new models can travel at speeds of up to 300mph, faster than Ukraine's air defence interceptors.

feed.headline: An Election in Sweden Shows Shifting Priorities
feed.ai: Sweden votes on Sunday. With various crises easing, center-left politics seem in vogue again, but the far right cannot be discounted.
